story:
It was a sunny day at Sunshine Elementary School. The kids were chatting excitedly as they waited in line for lunch. Soomin, a happy boy with bright blue eyes and curly brown hair, was looking forward to eating his favorite sandwich from his brand-new lunchbox.

But when he opened the cubby where he kept it, oh no! His lunchbox was gone! Soomin felt worried and sad. "My lunchbox is lost!" he cried out to his friend Emma.

Emma, a kind girl with long blonde hair and a warm smile, asked, "What's wrong, Soomin?" Soomin explained that his lunchbox had disappeared. Emma said, "Don't worry, I'll help you find it!"

Together, they searched the classroom. Mrs. Thompson, their teacher, suggested they ask their friends if they'd seen the lunchbox. They walked around the room and asked, "Have you seen Soomin's lunchbox?" But nobody had seen it.

Just then, Max, a clever boy with glasses, whispered to them, "Let me help! I'm good at solving mysteries." Emma said, "Great idea, Max!" The three friends started searching the classroom again. This time, they looked under the tables and behind the chairs.

Suddenly, they heard a faint sound... "Squeak, squeak!" It was Whiskers, their class pet mouse! She had somehow gotten stuck in Soomin's missing lunchbox!

The kids laughed with joy. Max carefully picked up the lunchbox, and Soomin exclaimed, "My lunchbox is back!" Emma said, "I'm so glad we found it together!"

Mrs. Thompson smiled and said, "Teamwork makes the dream work! You all helped each other out." The friends cheered and hugged each other.

Soomin was relieved to have his lunchbox back, but he also realized that helping others and staying kind always pays off. He said, "Thanks, friends! I'm lucky to have you guys as friends!"

The kids all agreed to be more careful with their belongings from now on. And Whiskers the mouse got a special treat for being part of the mystery-solving team!
